name: randi2023_neighbour_response_upper_bound
source_title: Neural signal propagation atlas of Caenorhabditis elegans -- Supplementary Information (MOESM1)
quote_or_location: SI 0.2.1: 'for neurons in the immediate vicinity of the targeted neuron, ~75% of stimulation events did not show obvious activation (Extended Data Fig. 2i,j), which places a worst-case-scenario extreme upper bound on off-target stimulation at ~25%. In practice, we suspect most of these nearby responses are not the result of off-target stimulation but rather are legitimate downstream responses'
notes: Authors' own statement; 'obvious activation' = ΔF/F0 > 0.1 in the 30-s window (ED Fig. 2j cross-hairs). The deposited Source Data give 38.4% > 0.1 for the 4-10 µm bin (see randi2023_EDFig2ij_frac_resp_gt0.1_4to10um), so the '~25%' figure is not reproduced from the deposited numbers. The bound is also not a bound on H2 alone: it lumps H1, H2, H3 and genuine downstream responses, and the 10-16 µm floor is 17.7%.

name: randi2023_EDFig2ij_frac_resp_gt0.1_4to10um
source_title: Neural signal propagation atlas of Caenorhabditis elegans -- Source Data Extended Data Fig. 2 (MOESM10)
quote_or_location: Source Data sheet EDFig2ij column '4um-10um' (n = 11,780 values); computed by us
notes: DERIVED BY US. 0 µm (target) column: n = 1,894, 92.0% > 0.1, median 0.395. 4-10 µm: median 0.058, 21.8% > 0.2. 10-16 µm: n = 21,211, 17.7% > 0.1, 7.0% > 0.2, median 0.014. There is NO 0-4 µm bin, bins are not identity- or connectivity-controlled, and 4-10 µm excess over 10-16 µm is ~2.2x at the 0.1 threshold. DISCREPANCY: SI says '~75% of stimulation events did not show obvious activation' for immediate-vicinity neurons (ED Fig. 2j cross-hair at 75% CDF, ΔF/F0 = 0.1), but the deposited 4-10 µm column gives P(ΔF/F0 <= 0.1) = 0.616 (0.593 for |ΔF/F0| <= 0.1); neither deposited bin gives 0.75 (10-16 µm: 0.823). Either the plotted curve used different data/processing or the SI rounds loosely; the worst-case bound implied by the deposited data is ~38%, not ~25%.
